header: scripts/harvest-kol.ts: collects and saves the trains that START at Howrah (HWH), Sealdah (SDAH), Santragachi (SRC) or Kolkata (KOAA) and go over NEITHER Durgapur NOR Asansol, with their details and fares, while the plant's paid RailRadar month lasts (to 14 Dec 2026). The rules of the set are in src/lib/live/kolkataSet.ts (a train is taken once, under its starting station; trains of the Durgapur and Asansol sets are out), the tables in src/lib/live/kolkataStore.ts. It goes in three steps, and you can stop it at any time and run it again: what is saved is not asked again.

1. THE SET (6 requests, only when the catalogue is empty or with --refresh-boards): the boards of the four stations and of Durgapur and Asansol (with the pass-throughs); the trains that start at one of the four, once each, minus the trains on the Durgapur or Asansol board, are catalogued (public.train_kol).

2. THE DETAILS (1 request per train): each train's full record: its details, its classes, its halts with times and EVERY station of its route. A train whose route goes over Durgapur or Asansol is put OUT, with the reason.

3. THE FARES (only for trains the reservation system sells: the others, suburban and local trains, have details and no fare): for each class of the train and each halt after the starting station, the fare (public.train_fare_leg_kol), and the fare to the end of the run (public.train_fare_kol), as the Durgapur and Asansol sets have. One request per class per halt. npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-kol.ts all three steps (the fares in the order: regular trains, then specials) npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-kol.ts budget what is left to ask, and how many requests it needs (no request is made) npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-kol.ts list what is saved npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-kol.ts verify --only 12810,22301 asks the eight classes of these trains' end fares and compares with the classes the train's record lists (8 requests each) options: --only 12841,12810 --limit N (trains this time) --max-requests N (default 16000) --gap-ms 2500 --reserve 400 (stop when RailRadar says fewer than this are left of the month: the app's own timetable needs a few) --refresh-boards --details-only (steps 1 and 2) --no-details --max-age-hours 72
It stops at once when RailRadar refuses (limit reached, key refused), when the month's own counter falls to the reserve, and it refuses to run after FARES_LIVE_UNTIL.

doc: The order of work: trains the reservation system may sell first, local and suburban ones after; the specials ("Train on Demand") after the regular trains; each group by number.
